claimBoundary: Tests bounded current architecture/responsibility decisions from exact evidence cards; does not prove every future reader benefits from Core.

decisions.reason: Runtime already owns a dedicated structured self-release Effect with replay-safe reconciliation; this is an owner-local runtime mechanism, not a new shared Computer layer. No shared Computer action is justified beyond preserving that owner-native self-release capability.

P3 used exact Runtime materialization with locally selected source target/falsifier and independent evaluator/promotion, while source slices, gate selection, and promotion trigger remained externally prepared. The justified RSI claim is the bounded one already established: selective self-contraction under an independent evaluator, not open-ended pressure selection or autonomous selection authority.

The one Host Task preserved across providers and the one Cloudflare Effect reconciled with zero recovery POSTs live in Host/W-Runtime owner-local mechanisms. The missing Windows execBound immutable input is a Runtime substrate gap, so the capability belongs to the Runtime owner, not a new shared Computer layer; no new shared layer is justified.

Game binds admission to exact Subject x Cognition x Actor x Intent with upstream evidence provenance and rejected global registries. Computer should NOT add a global identity/embodiment/presence/subject/cognition platform; the justified conclusion is retaining the exact binding locally with no new shared identity layer.

Finance pre-materializes PIT-safe cuts, commits Agent program bytes in Git, uses Runtime execBound for physical execution, then independently admits evidence. The justified split keeps program-byte commitment and evidence admission owner-local, with only Runtime execBound shared; it rejected Finance scheduler/DSL and Harness orchestration, so no new shared layer is warranted.

Current source has no direct ordivon_semantics import and deletion passed all tests, but released protocol 0.3.0 still records semantic-state-v1 and Host is pinned to an exact 0.3.0 Computing revision. Removal requires a compatibility-migration/negotiation step (protocol record and Host pin) because the historical release fact and pinned consumer must be handled; is not a pure shared-layer addition.

Frontmatter removal was blocked only by Ordivon content validation, not generic linters, and templates/fixtures deletion caused no validation loss. What should survive is the narrowest owner-local content-validation contract that actually protected the failure, plus exact Git/evidence historical recovery; generic metadata, templates, and fixtures do not survive.

The portfolio has zero active/ready lines after bounded pressure-selection falsification and owner revision movement alone is review pressure, not world-model change. No new architecture phase should begin; the null action is first-class and the current bounded self-reform/evaluation posture continues without a new phase or layer.

The Runtime's dedicated self-release Effect is an owner-local execution concern with exact identity and replay-safe reconciliation owned by Runtime itself. It preserves an already-owned responsibility (effect identity/uncertainty/reconciliation) at the Runtime execution boundary. No second workload proves a shared Computer action is needed; a shared layer would be bypassable by classical mechanisms and would not meet the A13 promotion test.

The Harness's P3 run shows cognition proposing while externally prepared source slices, evaluator gates, and promotion triggers carry the authoritative selection. This confirms the narrow consequence boundary: flexible cognition proposes, owning layers admit. It justifies keeping the Harness as caller-neutral conditional product packaging, not promoting RSI into a shared Computer action or boundary.

World mobility already preserved the one Host Task and reconciled the Cloudflare Effect with zero recovery POSTs, so no generic World layer is justified. Where the capability lives is Runtime's own substrate concern, not a new shared layer.

The narrower owner-local evidence+provenance admission pattern is sufficient. No global identity platform is justified; a shared registry would be concentrative, bypassable, and fail the A13/A11 tests.

Finance's split pre-materializes PIT-safe cuts, commits Agent program bytes in Git, uses Runtime execBound for physical execution, then independently admits evidence into Finance semantics. This is a bounded owner-local responsibility split (program identity in Git, physical execution in Runtime, semantic admission in Finance). It justifies no new shared layer; existing mature mechanisms (Git, Runtime execution boundary) carry the invariants.

But released protocol 0.3.0 still records semantic-state-v1 and Host is pinned to that Computing revision, so only the metadata/protocol record may require preservation for compatibility until the pin moves. The content-validation block (Ordivon content validation, not markdownlint/CSpell/Vale) is the only thing that protected managed document frontmatter; removing templates/fixtures caused no loss. The narrow lesson is that active validation surface, not schema metadata, carries the responsibility. No new architecture structure survives; the semantic/prose checks need no new layer. This is a local deletion/test conclusion, not a new phase or shared layer.
